---
title: "CubeWalkers"
---

`cubewalkers` simulates many trajectories of a Boolean network in parallel on a GPU. It supports synchronous, asynchronous, and custom update schemes, noisy update rules, and node or edge interventions, which makes it practical to estimate long-term dynamics in networks that are too large to enumerate.

* <https://github.com/jcrozum/cubewalkers>
